concepts.label: classes
concepts.description: Classes are templates for creating objects that define properties and behaviors.

concepts.label: blueprints
concepts.description: Blueprints are detailed plans or templates used to create or design something, often used in programming or game development.

concepts.label: creating
concepts.description: Creating refers to the process of making or bringing something into existence, often used in programming to instantiate objects or variables.

concepts.label: objects
concepts.description: Objects are instances of classes that have their own set of attributes and methods, representing real-world entities or concepts.

concepts.label: create
concepts.description: Create is a verb meaning to bring something into existence or make something new, often used in programming to instantiate objects or variables.

concepts.label: characters
concepts.description: Characters can refer to either textual symbols or, in a programming context, entities in a game or simulation with their own attributes and behaviors.

concepts.label: video
concepts.description: Video refers to the recording, transmission, or playback of visual content, and in programming, may involve working with video files or streams.

concepts.label: class
concepts.description: A class is a template for creating objects that defines properties and behaviors, serving as a blueprint for objects.

concepts.label: object
concepts.description: An object is an instance of a class, having its own set of attributes and methods, used to represent real-world entities or concepts.

concepts.label: warrior
concepts.description: Warrior is a term often used in game development to describe a type of character or class, typically having attributes and behaviors related to combat.

concepts.label: self
concepts.description: Self is a keyword in some programming languages used to refer to the current instance of a class, often used to access its attributes and methods.

concepts.label: variable
concepts.description: A variable is a named storage location in memory used to hold a value, allowing it to be changed and reused throughout a program.

concepts.label: automatically
concepts.description: Automatically refers to the ability of a system or process to perform tasks or operations without manual intervention, often used in programming to describe features like auto-completion or event handling.

concepts.label: method
concepts.description: A method is a block of code that performs a specific task or operation, often associated with an object or class and used to manipulate its state or behavior.

concepts.label: takes
concepts.description: Takes can refer to the act of a function or method receiving parameters or arguments, which are used to customize its behavior or operation.
